name: Rivulet
description: Modern screen recording and streaming software (OBS-style) built in Rust
_comment: Automation proposals for the OpenSSF Best Practices badge: the OSPS baseline-1 series (v2026.08.28, all 24 controls) and the metal-series passing level (the repo-evidenced criteria; behavioral ones stay unclaimed for the questionnaire). Schema and content are pinned by the ci_pinning guards bestpractices_json_claims_are_schema_valid_and_canonical, ossf_baseline_1_gap_closures_are_pinned and bestpractices_metal_passing_claims_are_pinned. See docs/openssf-best-practices.md. Field naming follows https://github.com/ossf/best-practices-badge/blob/main/docs/automation-proposals.md
osps_ac_01_01_justification: Hosted on GitHub, which has required two-factor authentication for all contributors since March 2023 (https://github.com/thoser666/Rivulet).
osps_ac_03_01_justification: The active branch ruleset on the primary branch develop (id 8577978) lists no bypass actors: a direct commit by any actor, including repository administrators, is rejected. Changes land only through pull requests that satisfy the required status checks (CI, Security, OpenSSF Scorecard, CodeQL (rust), Dependency Review, Pinning-Tests); the ruleset additionally prevents deletions and non-fast-forward updates.
osps_ac_02_01_justification: GitHub assigns collaborators the lowest available permission by default; access is granted manually per role, never auto-escalated.
osps_ac_03_02_justification: A GitHub branch ruleset on the primary branch develop enables branch deletion protection and non-fast-forward rules.
osps_br_01_01_justification: CI never pipes event metadata (branch names, commit messages, PR titles) into shell or scripts; release notes read commit subjects into Markdown text only (scripts/generate-release-notes.sh, scripts/check-release-notes.py).
osps_br_01_03_justification: Workflows triggered from fork PRs run without secrets; the only pull_request_target workflow (dependabot-auto-merge) is gated on the dependabot actor and never checks out PR code.
osps_br_03_01_justification: All official channels (GitHub repository, wiki, releases, docs) are served over HTTPS.
osps_br_03_02_justification: Release assets are distributed via GitHub Releases over TLS, and the updater verifies the SHA256SUMS digest before install (fail-closed).
osps_br_07_01_justification: GitHub Secret Scanning and Push Protection are enabled for the repository, .gitignore excludes secret-prone files, and a no-secrets rule is enforced in CONTRIBUTING.md.
osps_do_01_01_justification: User guides cover installation, configuration and usage: README.md, docs/user-guide.md, docs/macos-recording.md, docs/alerts.md, docs/twitch-chat.md and the project wiki.
osps_do_02_01_justification: README.md Bug reporting section and CONTRIBUTING.md point to the GitHub issue tracker (https://github.com/thoser666/Rivulet/issues) with template guidance.
osps_gv_02_01_justification: Public discussion happens through GitHub Issues, pull requests and the project wiki (https://github.com/thoser666/Rivulet/wiki).
osps_gv_03_01_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md documents the full contribution workflow: branch strategy, PR process against develop, code-review policy, Definition of Done and release process.
osps_le_02_01_justification: The source code is released under the MIT license, an OSI-approved and FSF-free license.
osps_le_02_02_justification: Released binaries are built from the MIT-licensed source; no different license is applied to released assets.
osps_le_03_01_justification: The MIT license text is maintained in the repository LICENSE file at the root.
osps_le_03_02_justification: The release workflows (release.yml for alpha, ci.yml for beta/rc/stable tags) copy the LICENSE file into the release-assets folder before generating SHA256SUMS, so the MIT license is attached to every GitHub Release alongside the binaries and covered by the checksum manifest.
osps_qa_01_01_justification: The source repository is publicly readable at the static URL https://github.com/thoser666/Rivulet.
osps_qa_01_02_justification: GitHub hosts a publicly readable commit history recording every change, its author and timestamp.
osps_qa_02_01_justification: Direct dependencies are enumerated in Cargo.toml manifests with Cargo.lock pinning and deny.toml policy.
osps_qa_04_01_justification: The README 'Repositories' section documents the project's codebases: the primary thoser666/Rivulet repository (application + engine, built into every release) and the thoser666/Rivulet.wiki documentation companion, each with its status and intent.
osps_qa_05_01_justification: No generated executable artifacts are tracked in the repository (verified by CI hygiene checks); binaries are produced at build time in CI.
osps_qa_05_02_justification: No unreviewable binary artifacts are committed; only image/text assets such as icons (rivulet-gui/assets) are tracked.
osps_vm_02_01_justification: SECURITY.md documents security contacts and the coordinated-disclosure process; docs/security.md adds detail and a response timeline.
description_good_justification: README.md opens with a one-sentence description of what the software does (modern screen recording and streaming software built in Rust) followed by a feature list and roadmap.
interact_justification: The README links installation, the user guide, the first-stream checklist, help, contributing and bug reporting, and GitHub Issues/PRs are open for feedback.
contribution_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md documents the full contribution process (branch strategy, PR flow against develop, code review policy): https://github.com/thoser666/Rivulet/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md
contribution_requirements_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md lists the requirements for acceptable contributions in its Definition of Done section: https://github.com/thoser666/Rivulet/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md
floss_license_justification: The project is released under the MIT license (repository LICENSE file); the software is produced by the project itself.
license_location_justification: The MIT license text is maintained in the repository root LICENSE file: https://github.com/thoser666/Rivulet/blob/develop/LICENSE
documentation_basics_justification: User guides cover installation, configuration and usage: README.md, docs/user-guide.md, docs/first-stream-checklist.md, docs/stream-setup.md, docs/macos-recording.md.
sites_https_justification: The repository, wiki, releases and all official channels referenced in documentation are served over HTTPS (github.com).
discussion_justification: Public discussion happens through GitHub Issues, pull requests and the project wiki: https://github.com/thoser666/Rivulet/issues
english_justification: All documentation is written in English (German translations are provided for the UI and key guides).
repo_public_justification: The source repository is publicly readable: https://github.com/thoser666/Rivulet
repo_track_justification: All changes are tracked in git with a public history of authors and timestamps: https://github.com/thoser666/Rivulet/commits/develop
repo_interim_justification: Interim versions between releases are visible on the develop branch and per-release branches: https://github.com/thoser666/Rivulet/tree/develop
version_unique_justification: Every release has a unique semantic version tag (e.g. v0.65.0-alpha.132): https://github.com/thoser666/Rivulet/releases
release_notes_justification: Every GitHub Release carries notes generated from the actual commits since the previous tag (scripts/generate-release-notes.sh), completeness-checked in CI: https://github.com/thoser666/Rivulet/releases
report_process_justification: The README Bug reporting section and CONTRIBUTING.md point to the GitHub issue tracker: https://github.com/thoser666/Rivulet/issues
report_tracker_justification: Bugs are tracked in the public GitHub issue tracker: https://github.com/thoser666/Rivulet/issues
report_archive_justification: GitHub preserves the full public issue and pull-request archive: https://github.com/thoser666/Rivulet/issues
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: SECURITY.md documents how to report vulnerabilities and the coordinated-disclosure process: https://github.com/thoser666/Rivulet/blob/develop/SECURITY.md
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: SECURITY.md points to GitHub private vulnerability reporting for coordinated disclosure: https://github.com/thoser666/Rivulet/security/advisories/new
build_justification: The project builds from source with cargo build on the pinned toolchain (workspace); build and test commands are documented in README Development/Tests and CONTRIBUTING.md.
test_justification: A substantial automated test suite runs via cargo test in CI on three operating systems (core unit/integration, GUI, obs-websocket, smoke and pinning tests).
test_invocation_justification: The README Tests section and CONTRIBUTING.md document the exact cargo test invocations used locally and in CI.
test_policy_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md Definition of Done requires tests for new functionality (the project's formal test policy).
warnings_justification: CI runs clippy with -D warnings and rustfmt checks in the Lints job; warning-emitting code fails the build.
warnings_fixed_justification: The CI Lints job fails on any compiler or clippy warning (-D warnings), so merged code is kept warning-free.
static_analysis_justification: Static analysis runs in CI: clippy -D warnings, CodeQL (rust), Cargo Audit, Cargo Deny and the OpenSSF Scorecard workflow.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: GitHub Secret Scanning and Push Protection are enabled; secret-prone files are gitignored and CONTRIBUTING.md enforces a no-secrets rule.
delivery_mitm_justification: Release assets are distributed over HTTPS via GitHub Releases and verified against a published SHA256SUMS manifest (the updater fails closed on mismatch).
dynamic_analysis_justification: Dynamic analysis via cargo-fuzz targets for the untrusted parsers (Twitch IRC, SDP, updater JSON) with a CI smoke run and a weekly deep campaign (fuzz-deep.yml).
